name: Cluster Hierarchy-based Volume Rendering
aliases: Interactive Visual Exploration of Multi-variate Volume Data
definition: A rendering approach that maps hierarchical clusters of multi-variate data to transfer function parameters (color, opacity, size) for direct volume rendering, allowing interactive exploration via cluster tree and parallel coordinates widgets.
summary: Cluster Hierarchy-based Volume Rendering enables interactive exploration of multi-variate data by decoupling CPU-based clustering from GPU rendering via mask-based post-classification.
